title: Your first granny square
description: Four rounds, one colour, about 45 minutes. If you can make a chain and a double crochet, you can make this.

mediaFiles.altText: A finished cream granny square on a wooden table

materials.name: Cotton yarn
materials.note: Worsted weight, a light colour so you can see the stitches

steps.text: Make a magic ring and chain 3. This counts as your first double crochet.
Work 2 double crochet into the ring, chain 2, then (3 double crochet, chain 2) three more times. Pull the ring closed.

mediaFile.altText: Round 1: four clusters of three stitches around a closed ring

steps.text: Slip stitch into the top of the first chain 3 to join. Round 1 done.
